query:
DELETE FROM livetv_guide g
        WHERE g.channel_id = $1
          AND g.start_time >= $2
          AND g.start_time <= $3
          AND g.start_time <> ALL($4)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM livetv_recordings r
              WHERE r.guide_id = g.id AND r.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'moved')
          )
